High bid is $210 vs $280 list. I own zero yellows and already have singles in light blue, orange, and red. Winning means a bidding war with cash-rich p4 ($1475, zero properties) and leaves me thinner for Tennessee/New York or the other reds. Drop and keep $1014 liquid.

No set, nothing to build, $1014 liquid. Mortgaging is waste. p3's St. Charles doesn't complete orange without unowned New York, so no trade worth chasing. Keep cash for Tennessee, NY, reds, or yellow leftovers. End turn.
